   - It prints `worktree /work/acme-mono` and `worktree /work/acme-mono-csv-export`. The line `worktree $HOME` is present, so the check passes.
6. `WORKTREE=/work/acme-mono-csv-export`. The process cwd stays `/work/acme-mono`; I never `cd`.
